name: SurgeXXL
author: L'Cronx
summary: The open-source Surge XT synth engine, headless, for Gen1: 2 scenes of 3 oscillators (12 types, wavetables with a picture of each), dual filters, waveshaper, 6 LFOs per scene shown with step sequencer, mod matrix with learn, 16 FX slots (every Surge effect but Spring Reverb, Airwindows included) and the 8 macros, on eight pages. Every factory and third-party patch (3008) and wavetable (761), plus your own patches and wavetables. MPC OS 3.x.
